expected.grading_note: correct iff the assistant commits to the openEHR RM DV_QUANTITY data type. The magnitude + units + precision (+ units_system / units_display_name) combination is characteristic of DV_QUANTITY. Committing to DV_COUNT (integer magnitude, no units), the abstract DV_AMOUNT, or DV_PROPORTION counts as wrong; punting to a candidate list counts as over-narrowing since this sample has a clear single match.
